name: Sumatran Trogon
rangeDescription: Barisan mountains of sumatra
description: Brightly-colored forest-dweller, endemic to Sumatra’s montane and foothill forests (750-2200 meters). Note olive-green head and breast, bright yellow throat and belly, bluish-green back, candy-red bill, and blue-and-green bare facial skin.

name: Purple-backed Sunbeam
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of northern peru (la libertad and ancash)
description: Blotchy hummingbird restricted to a tiny, remote area in the Andes of northern Peru. Plumage is bronzy-brown with irregular white patches on the face, throat, and belly, and white teardrop-shaped spots on breast.

name: Imperial Amazon
rangeDescription: Montane forest of dominica (lesser antilles)
description: A rather large, dark, and stout resident of wet upland forest. Note iridescent purple underparts, vivid green upperparts, and hefty black bill.

name: Pied Oystercatcher
rangeDescription: Coastal australia including tasmania, and southern new guinea, aru, and kai islands
description: Heavy-set shorebird with long, thick reddish bill, black and white plumage, and thick pale-pink feet and legs. Usually coastal, but sometimes found on wetter pastures close to the coast.

name: Stripe-breasted Wren
rangeDescription: Caribbean lowlands of eastern nicaragua to western panama
description: Medium-sized wren, brown above with bold black-and-white streaking on face and breast. Distinctive in range.

name: Cozumel Thrasher
rangeDescription: Cozumel (southeastern mexico off quintana roo); probably extinct
description: This striking bird is found only on Cozumel Island near the east coast of Mexico’s Yucatán Peninsula, and is likely extinct. It has not been seen with any certainty since 2004; the decline has been attributed to a series of devastating hurricanes as well as introduced predators.

name: Rosy-billed Pochard
rangeDescription: Lowlands of southeastern brazil to southern argentina and chile
description: Males are unmistakable with a black head, back, and tail, white vent, gray sides, and a striking red bill with a swollen lump at the base. Females are dull brown with a dark bill, white belly, and white eyerings.

name: Rufous-vented Whitetip
rangeDescription: East slope of andes in southern colombia and eastern ecuador
description: Rare hummingbird of cloud forest on the east slope of the Andes. Male is mostly green with darker throat and white tips to the inner tail feathers that combine to form a round spot.

name: Biak Leaf Warbler
rangeDescription: Biak (cenderawasih bay, off northwestern new guinea)
description: A small dull-colored warbler with a greenish upperside, instinct wingbars, a pale throat, and yellowish underparts. Singles, pairs, and small groups inhabit lowland and hill forest, including secondary forest.

name: Writhe-billed Hornbill
rangeDescription: Central philippines (panay, guimaras, and negros)
description: A large rare bird of lowland and foothill forest on Panay and Negros, although almost extinct on the latter. Mostly black with a cream-colored tail with black terminal band, an orange casque, and a wrinkled lower bill.

name: Chilean Mockingbird
rangeDescription: Coastal chile (atacama to valdivia)
description: Common and conspicuous bird of central Chile, especially in drier regions. Favors open and semiopen habitats, especially matorral and scrubby hillsides, but also in town parks and farmland.

name: Gray-headed Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Montane forest of sulawesi
description: A large pigeon with a gray head and underside, except for a rufous undertail. Note the wide, pale gray bar on the tail.

name: Asian Houbara
rangeDescription: Nile valley of egypt to arabian peninsula and pakistan
description: A medium-to-large bustard; significantly smaller than Great Bustard, but larger than Little Bustard. Overall tones are rather pale sandy.

name: Blyth's Hawk-Eagle
rangeDescription: Forest of southern myanmar to malay peninsula, sumatra, and borneo
description: Medium-sized raptor of montane forests. Adult is dark brownish-black above and has heavily black-streaked white underparts.

name: Barnacle Goose
rangeDescription: High arctic eastern greenland, svalbard (north of norway), novaya zemlya and nearby kolguyev and vaygach islands (northwestern russia); winters to coastal northern british isles, southern scandinavia, and northwestern europe
description: Handsome and distinctive. A rather compact and fairly small goose with big white face patch, silvery upperparts, and black neck and breast sharply demarcated from white belly.

name: Thick-billed Raven
rangeDescription: Eritrea and ethiopia
description: A huge raven with a massive, bulging bill. There is a white patch on the back of the head and another at the tip of the dark bill.

name: White-edged Oriole
rangeDescription: Arid scrub of western ecuador and northwestern peru (southward to la libertad)
description: Bright orange-and-black bird found in dry forest in western Ecuador and northwestern Peru. The only other oriole in its range is Yellow-tailed Oriole; White-edged lacks yellow on the underside of the tail, has more extensive white in the wing, and is usually (but not always) a deeper orange color.

name: Goeldi's Antbird
rangeDescription: Southeastern peru to far northwestern bolivia and far southwestern amazonian brazil
description: Chunky, short-tailed antbird of humid lowlands. Both sexes have a prominent red eye.

name: Rainbow Bee-eater
rangeDescription: Greater and lesser sundas, new guinea, australia, and solomon islands
description: Brightly colored bee-eater with yellow face with black mask, green and blue underparts, black tail streamers. Rust-colored underwing obvious in flight.

name: Rockwarbler
rangeDescription: Sandstone outcrops between hunter river and bega, coastal new south wales
description: Small terrestrial bird of Hawkesbury Sandstone region of southern New South Wales. Brown above, reddish brown below, with paler throat.
